outcome: mRNA and protein levels of interleukin (IL)-1b
mRNA and protein levels of IL-6
mRNA and protein levels of tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-a
mRNA and protein levels of IL-10
Protein levels of B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia/lymphoma (Bcl)-2
Protein levels of Bcl-2-associated X protein (Bax)
Protein levels of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor (Nrf)-2
cohort: Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly divided into five groups: control, I/R, and three different crocetin-treated I/R groups.
finding: Pre-administration of crocetin effectively alleviates I/R-induced oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis, and tissue injury, likely through activating the Nrf-2/HO-1 pathway, in a dose-dependent manner.
followup_time: 3 hours after reperfusion (for observation of I/R injury effects)
